title: Strips, rolled up
summary: Header X's approved body, kept: the page's second statement and four strips that repeat the band's flag codes. New beneath them is a 1px roll-up, where each strip's artifact drops onto one of the two assets you own, so the taxonomy reads at a glance.
story: The legend to the header's map. The band flagged four services; here they are by name, what each ships, and where it lands: three into the Narrative OS, one into the Channel Playbooks — the two assets the facts ledger promised.
copy: [K X] statement “The story is not copy. / It’s infrastructure.” and the four strip lines and Ships values
[R] support line “Four services, each shipping into one of two assets you own.”
[N] the roll-up (Narrative OS ← 01.1, 01.2, 01.4 · Channel Playbooks ← 01.3) and its words “Into the Narrative OS / Channel Playbooks”
phone: ≤1023: strips 2 × 2; the roll-up drawing gives way to its words in each strip (“Into the Narrative OS”). ≤767: one strip per row, the code box beside the title (22px), the support line, then ‘Ships · …’ and ‘Into the …’ on one wrapping foot line.
